name: nerveops
description: NerveOps — M0-01 executable foundation shells (no M1/M2 domain behavior)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nerveops/web && npm run build --workspace @nerveops/control-plane && python3 -m compileall apps/runtime-api apps/runtime-worker apps/celery-worker
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace @nerveops/web && npm run type-check --workspace @nerveops/control-plane && python3 scripts/check-python-shells.py
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @nerveops/web --if-present && npm run test --workspace @nerveops/control-plane --if-present && python3 -m pytest tests/m0_01_shell_contract -q
